addr: Ground Floor, 421/A, 80 Feet Rd, 6th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560095, India

rev.t:
This place is definitely overrated.

Does not justify the price point for the ingredients mentioned …

Very average place. I ordered a hazelnut pastry from here which the server heated (not sure why because it was cream based). The pastry looked decent but it had go be stale because I got food poisioning after. …

Old dried up food with funky smell sold at a premium. This business is nothing but a scam. I placed the order through on swiggy raised a complaint but did not even receive an apology. Worst experience
